answer: Each fake agent identity costs an attacker 1,000 staked tokens, slashed to zero on one proven fraud report. Sybils die because minting identities is cheap but backing them is not. Reputation accretes like a pearl, slow and layered, worthless if nucleated by a stolen key. The ledger sits like karst rock: solid surface, few entrances, every cave audited. New agents arrive on a zephyr of zero history and must escrow that bond before any peer attests, so flooding costs more than it steals.
